text:
incident-bot: ALERT: service:redwood-vectorizer (rule: canary-5xx-spike) — 5xx rate 180/min on ap-southeast-1 canary pool over 4m. Auto-escalate in 1m if unacked.

pagerduty-bot: PD INC-86042 triggered -> paging @oncall_jules (primary).

oncall_jules: acked. looking at grafana. which deployment pushed recently?

eng_tom: rolled `vectorizer-v4.0.0-canary-b` ~11m ago (A/B canary, 20% traffic). change: new quantized kernel + request coalescing for small vectors.

eng_ops_rita: metrics: 5xxs heavily correlated with canary tag; p95 latency up 2x. interestingly errors spike on small payloads (<32 tokens). heap/CPU on canary nodes normal.

support_maya: two partner integrations reported elevated failures in APAC webhooks. tickets open, one escalated to account manager.

oncall_jules: immediate mitigations: 1) abort/stop canary traffic 2) enable circuit-breaker for vectorizer small-payload path 3) if persistent, rollback canary. who's on traffic?

eng_tom: running traffic abort: `redwoodctl rollout set-split --service redwood-vectorizer --canary vectorizer-v4.0.0-canary-b --percent 0`

eng_tom: cli: 
```
Updating split config...\nApplied: canary vectorizer-v4.0.0-canary-b -> 0%\nStable receives 100% traffic
```

incident-bot: action: traffic split updated by eng_tom at 1967002582

eng_ops_rita: circuit breaker toggle: `cfgctl set vectorizer.coalesce.small_payload.enabled false --env=prod --region=ap-southeast-1` -> applied.

eng_ops_rita: logs: 5xx rate started to drop within 30s, from 180/min -> 8/min. still seeing a handful of failures from draining proxies.

pagerduty-bot: PD INC-86042 status: acknowledged by oncall_jules; escalation stopped.

support_maya: customer comms: sending an interim message: "We detected increased errors on embedding/vectorization calls after a routine canary. Traffic has been routed back to stable and a mitigation applied. We're investigating."

oncall_jules: handoff to oncall rotation in 45m? If stable, I'll resolve and document. Also want a quick check for data integrity — any DL/ML jobs impacted?

eng_tom: vectorizer is stateless for live requests; batch offline jobs unaffected. tracing shows many errors are `quant_kernel: rv64: invalid opcode` from one specific variant of GPU driver when handling sub-32 token coalesced requests — seems like edge-case in quant path. attaching sample trace.

acct_mgr_dan: pinging impacted customer contacts; they want an RCA and timeline. I told them we're on it.

eng_ops_rita: rolling back canary images from nodes: `kubectl -n prod set image deployment/vectorizer-canary vectorizer=redwood/vectorizer:stable-3.9.5` -> scaled down canary pods gracefully. Note: image pull to stable took ~25s on some nodes due to registry cold-start.

eng_tom: queued CI job to reproduce small-payload coalescing with quant path; initial run reproduces failure locally. filing repro ticket.

oncall_jules: set PD to watch for 30m; if no regression, we'll resolve. please keep thread updated with customer-facing notes.

support_maya: updated tickets with mitigation times and next steps. asked customers to validate reconnects — they reported restored service within 2 minutes of mitigation.

incident-bot: autopage suppression enabled for PD INC-86042 during mitigation window to avoid duplicates.

eng_ops_rita: monitoring: residual 5xxs now ~2-3/min (drain noise). p95 latency back to baseline.

oncall_jules: since we saw a driver-specific failure, I'm recommending we: - mark canary image as blocked from further rollouts - add a gating kernel compatibility test in CI - schedule full postmortem if root cause confirmed. who owns the postmortem?

eng_tom: i'll own the postmortem and the fix PR to disable coalescing when quantized kernels are used until we ship a driver-safe variant.

acct_mgr_dan: customers requested prioritized patch; i'll coordinate SLAs and expectations.

pagerduty-bot: PD INC-86042 status: resolved by oncall_jules at 1967003778

support_maya: final customer note: "Issue caused by a canary rollout. Traffic was routed to stable and temporary mitigations applied. No customer data loss; transient 502/5xx errors observed for a subset of small payload requests. Engineering investigating. Will follow up with RCA."

oncall_jules: incident severity = P2 (customer-visible transient errors, recoverable). Timeline: page 1967002468 -> traffic abort 1967002582 -> circuit breaker 1967002605 -> errors reduced 1967002635 -> rollback completion 1967003200 -> PD resolved 1967003778.

eng_tom: filing BUG-1237 "quant kernel + coalesce path triggers invalid opcode for <32 token payloads on driver X.Y" with logs, test case, and CI repro. tagging eng-runtime, eng-ml, eng-qa.

incident-bot: thread archived at 1967003780
